decision.rationale: Independent semantic review of the exact digest-bound M2 v0.3 authority candidate within its declared scope; this is not terminal release adoption.

externalContextEvidence.statement: BIPM defines quantities that are numbers of entities as quantities with the unit one and permits clearly documented descriptive terms; BIPM does not define the Axiolune term share.

normativeScope.scope: M2 Slice-A direct-unit security quotation denominators only

units.definition: one unit of a security issue quantity used as the denominator of a direct unit-price quotation
units.label: Share
